question: An adversary exploits insufficient permissions to upload a server-side script that can be executed remotely, acting as a gateway to the web server and enabling elevated code execution. Which MITRE ATT&CK technique corresponds to this behavior, and why does it map to this attack pattern?
answer:
- T1505.003.
- T1505.003 corresponds to web-accessible remote command gateways, mapping CAPEC-650: uploading an executable web shell for remote, elevated control.
